ios.desc:
Famous: Authentic Short Videos, Private Chat, & Social Albums  
  
Feeling lost in the noise of social media? Famous is designed to bring people closer through genuine connections, private sharing, and authentic self-expression within a safe and respectful environment.
Create, share, and connect without focusing on algorithms. Here, it’s about meaningful connections with friends and family, and conversations that matter.

Your Short Video & Sharing Hub
We’ve designed Famous to be a space for short-form video content and daily sharing.
Authentic Short Videos: Capture, edit, and share daily video updates and creative short-form content that reflect your life.

Private Photo Albums & Stories: Create dedicated, private photo albums and updates, sharing moments only with the people you trust.

Deepen Connections with TALK Rooms
Famous isn't just a place to watch videos; it's a social messenger built for connection.
Connect in TALK Rooms: Join group conversations and discussions with friends, family, or like-minded individuals.
Private Chat Messenger: Send secure messages and stay connected with the people who matter most.

A Safe & Positive Community
Famous is built to support respectful interaction and meaningful connections.
Content is moderated to maintain a safe environment

Users can report inappropriate content
Community guidelines help ensure a positive experience
Famous is more than a short video app—it’s a place to connect, share, and build real relationships.
Download Famous today and start sharing your moments.

android.desc:
Famous™: Short Videos. Real Vibes. Global Connections.
Feeling lost in the noise of fleeting likes and endless filters? Famous™ breaks free from the superficial by giving creators, dreamers, and everyday people a space to share authentic short videos that inspire, uplift, and spread good vibes around the world.
This isn’t just another social video app. Famous™ is where creativity meets community, and every moment has the power to spark real connection. Our mission is simple: empower people to share their stories, discover inspiring content, and connect through video in a way that feels real, positive, and lasting.
🎬 Share Your Vibe Through Short Videos
Record and post daily short videos to capture your true self — no filters required.
Express your creativity in seconds and let your personality shine.
From quick updates to inspiring moments, every video you share helps shape your story.
Join challenges, discover trends, or simply share your vibe with friends and new audiences.
🌍 Connect Through Good Vibes
Discover trending short videos from creators worldwide.
Celebrate positivity with a community built on encouragement, not judgment.
Follow, comment, and engage in a space designed for authentic self-expression.
Get inspired by real people sharing real moments.
🚀 Go Live, Go Global
Start a live stream instantly and share your world in real time.
Connect with friends, fans, or new audiences across the globe.
Build your community as you broadcast your vibe — unfiltered, unscripted, and 100% you.
Interact directly with your viewers and grow your influence through live video.
💬 TALK Rooms That Matter 
Move beyond likes and fleeting trends — join dedicated rooms for real conversations.
Chat with family, friends, or people who share your passions.
Turn short videos into long-lasting connections through meaningful discussions.
✨ What Makes Famous™ Different?
Authenticity first: No fake filters, no pressure — just your real self.
Good vibes only: A community that uplifts, celebrates, and inspires.
Video at the center: Every swipe is a chance to discover something new and positive.
Built for connection: Short videos are just the beginning — real relationships are the goal.
Inclusive by design: Famous™ is for everyone — creators, fans, families, and communities.

quotes.text:
We’re a small team building Famous™, a new short-video platform designed for authentic sharing and real-life moments. No algorithmic feeds, no superficial metrics — just genuine discovery and connection.

The beta is live for iOS, Android, and Web. Creators and early adopters are welcome to try it and share feedback.

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/famous/id1319085022  
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=tm.famous.app.mobile&hl=en_US  
Web: https://famoustm.com/signup

Would love your thoughts on how we can make this a meaningful alternative for creators and viewers alike.
